routes.claim: The exact v4.2 ReviewService can lose writes under the recorded synchronized interleaving.
routes.counterevidence: The natural unsynchronized attempt was inconclusive, and production frequency is not proven.

routes.claim: Eight cooperating child processes preserve eight distinct review items through the v4.3 lease.
routes.counterevidence: The lease does not exclude noncooperating external writers and is not a multi-host guarantee.

routes.claim: Crash residue and invalid or altered owner evidence remain present and block later mutation.
routes.counterevidence: No process-liveness inference, automatic stale-owner theft, or protected rollback-resistant custody is claimed.

routes.claim: Signed submit, vote, and recovery place envelope handling, intent persistence, and ordinary projection inside the shared lease.
routes.counterevidence: Serialization is not cross-file atomicity and grants no review, execution, or reconciliation authority.

routes.claim: Nine selected review and downstream checks pass in a clean 583-file archived product slice without tracked-file drift.
routes.counterevidence: The successful replay is a selected product slice, not a full-repository archive replay.

routes.claim: The committed UI exposes held owner metadata, disables voting while held, retains typed selected evidence, has no unlock control, and wraps at 390x844.
routes.counterevidence: Synthetic localhost visual fixtures do not prove assistive-technology compatibility, human usability, or human benefit.

routes.claim: The seam grants no execution, adoption, promotion, merge, Foundation mutation, or CANON authority.
routes.counterevidence: Actual live host policy, signed human review, identity, trusted time, benefit, learning, merge, and CANON remain unproven.
